supersession_reason: v1.1 remains the immutable pre-Step-3 plan. v1.2 records the terminal six-case local Evidence Pack result and narrows external supplement to a bounded set of decision-relevant residual gaps.
user_decision: Execute steps 1-5 in order without requesting approval at every substep; preserve exact-once authorities and stop at a newly established L1 blocker rather than silently expanding or retrying.

execution_sequence.decision: ObjectBM25 is the primary Candidate route; BGE-M3 is shadow expansion; fusion is not the global default. No reranker or result-driven weight tuning.

All 93 manifest candidates and 19 narrative-queue items were read and adjudicated. Candidate Slot labels are hints only; content-not-decision-relevant items are rejected, bounded context cannot be rewritten as issuer-specific fact, and numeric Evidence retains table, period, unit, currency and source lineage.

execution_sequence.acceptance: Compile the 126 raw facet gaps into a small, explicit set of high-decision-value and source-obtainable SearchIntents. Official issuer, counterparty and regulator routes lead; a broad provider may locate URLs only. Every selected document is recaptured, date-checked and re-adjudicated locally before Evidence promotion.
execution_sequence.stop_rule: Do not mechanically search all raw gaps, do not use provider snippets as Evidence, do not retry an exhausted provider, and preserve an honest typed gap when authoritative material is unavailable.

execution_sequence.acceptance: First score financial analysis and synthesis on the same frozen Evidence Pack; then separately score dynamic planning, query/tool use, residual-gap handling, mechanisms, counterevidence, what-would-change and report quality.

known_boundary: Steps 1-3 establish a searchable local corpus and reviewed local Evidence Packs. They do not establish full external coverage, DeepSeek analysis quality, a complete investment report or release acceptance. The 126 count is a raw facet inventory, not a network-call target.
